data.title: When evaluation becomes intervention in clinical AI
data.description: arXiv:2611.18297v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: AI judges, models that grade another system's output against a rubric, extend clinical review to the scale at which clinical AI writes. When teams use judge assessments to select a prompt or train a model, the judge becomes part of the intervention. Selection can then favor errors the judge overlooks. We describe what a judge's report must contain and the independent clinical test each judge-driven change needs.
data.author: Anthony Abou Mrad, Aviona Conti, Jayanth Pratap, Ruhika Iyer, Joseph Kim, King Shi, Yann Sakref, Luis M. Ahumada, Lisa Knowlton, Andrew M. Cameron, Khyzer Aziz, Jeffrey K. Jopling
